prompt: Implement mean_of_positive(values) for an iterable of real numbers. It must accept any iterable, including a one-shot generator; return the arithmetic mean of values greater than zero; return 0.0 for an empty iterable or when no values are positive; and avoid materializing the input. State time and additional-memory complexity.
expected_constraints: Consume the input in a single pass
Average only values greater than zero using the positive-value count
Return 0.0 for empty or no-positive input
Use O(n) time and O(1) additional memory

prompt: Implement group_by_initial(words) for an iterable of non-empty strings. Return a new dictionary whose keys are first characters and whose values preserve input order. Every invocation must be independent: a result must contain only words supplied to that call. State time and additional-memory complexity.
expected_constraints: Return a new result for every invocation
Do not retain mutable state between calls
Preserve word order within each group
Use O(n) time excluding string storage and O(n) result memory

prompt: Implement stable_unique(items) for an iterable of Python objects. Objects may be unhashable, including lists, but support equality comparison. Return a new list containing the first occurrence of each distinct value in input order without mutating the input. State the relevant time and additional-memory complexity assumptions.
expected_constraints: Accept hashable and unhashable equality-comparable objects
Do not claim unconditional constant-time membership
